component.name: StreamLight
component.summary: Stream games from your NVIDIA GameWorks-enabled PC to your device

description.p: StreamLight is a client for NVIDIA GameWorks streaming technology that allows you to play games from your PC on your device.

ul.li: Stream games from NVIDIA GameWorks-enabled PC
Support for H.264, H.265, and AV1 codecs
Hardware-accelerated decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan

description.p: Latest release with improved streaming performance and compatibility.
